$comment: Tavus Objectives: a branching checklist of the CMS pre-enrollment topics, condensed for a four-minute call. Tavus's evaluator marks each complete as the call goes, which keeps Anna moving through them in order.

objectives.objective_prompt: The caller says whether they're okay with the conversation being transcribed. If they decline, thank them, tell them they can call Harbor to speak with a licensed advisor directly, and end the call.
Learn whether the caller is turning 65 soon or already has Medicare, and what coverage they have today (employer coverage, Medicaid, an existing Medicare plan, or none).

next_conditional_objectives.note_dual_eligibility: The caller has Medicaid, Extra Help, or says they have limited income.

objectives.objective_prompt: Let the caller know they may qualify for extra help or special plans, and that the licensed advisor will check this with them. Then continue.
Learn which doctors the caller wants to keep and which medications they take, checking each one with the lookup tools.
Learn what matters most to the caller when choosing a plan (monthly cost, keeping a doctor, drug costs, travel, extras like dental or vision).
The caller either books a call with a licensed Harbor advisor at a specific time, or says they only want information for now.
